title: Everyone's Future Call Came By BREAKFAST 🕛
description:
I turned thirty today. Everybody else's call from later came by breakfast.

By 11:57 that night, mine still hadn't. My mom and I sat at her kitchen table, under fourteen clocks, and waited.

It's made up. A blocky story, built with code and Blender.
pin: Future me was in Mom's kitchen, and her clocks were still ten minutes fast. Who's keeping them fast by then, Mom or me?
